_format.summary: WeChat: one chat room, #millbrook. Seven nights (Sun Oct 24 to Sat Oct 30, 2004), 2 or 3 scenes a night. At each scene's notify_at the player gets a notification (the 'notification' text); opening WeChat plays that scene's beats in order, a line at a time.
_format.scene: id, notify_at (in-game clock), notification (toast text), beats. Optional requires: {flag: true/false}.
_format.beat (line): from: a handle, or '*' for a system line (joins, parts, away messages, timestamps). text uses sites.json markup ([[url|text]] links, BBCode). Optional me: true for a /me action. Optional whisper: true for a private message to the player that the rest of the room can't see. Optional if / unless: a flag; skip the beat when the condition fails.
_format.beat (prompt): prompt: a list of options. The scene pauses until the player picks one. Each option: text (what the player posts as night411), reply (beats played right after), optional set: [flags], optional whisper_to: a handle (the player's line is a private whisper to them), optional silent: true (the player says nothing; text is only the menu label), optional if / unless. Every prompt has at least one unconditional option.
_format.flags: Global and persistent across nights. See 'flags' for what each one means.
